issues.symptom: Multiple hardcoded API and database ports found
issues.root_cause: Lack of centralized service discovery and dynamic port assignment
issues.architectural_cause: Services assume static IP/port bindings, violating Phase 3 Service Orchestration
issues.fix_strategy: Implement dynamic registration, heartbeat, and routing table. Remove localhost:* defaults.
issues.verification_strategy: System fails to build or start if hardcoded ports are found

issues.root_cause: Multiple versions of predictors existing across research, aqea, and quant engine
issues.architectural_cause: Lack of single model registry. Code duplication due to experimental features not being merged or cleaned up.
issues.fix_strategy: Consolidate into ONE predictor registry and single schema. Delete legacy copies.
issues.verification_strategy: Search for duplicate file names or classes. Build fails if duplicate found.

issues.root_cause: Feature definitions duplicated in TypeScript and Python
issues.architectural_cause: No shared schema authority between Quant Engine and Node Server
issues.fix_strategy: Create shared/schemas. TS schema and Python schema must match exactly or read from shared JSON.
issues.verification_strategy: Runtime payload and schema dimensions match exactly.

issues.symptom: Usage of process.cwd() for path resolution
issues.architectural_cause: Violates Execution Lockdown Mode Phase 3 orchestration rules
issues.fix_strategy: Eliminate process.cwd(). Use absolute paths, __dirname, or environment variables.
issues.verification_strategy: Grep for process.cwd() fails build if found.
